stages.title: Accounts and recovery
stages.depends: Start here. Verified domain/sender and account access are prerequisites.
stages.gate: Reset, sign-in, settings and deletion flows pass end-to-end checks.

tasks.name: Verified email delivery
tasks.how: Connect a verified sender so account messages reach the correct address; confirm delivery and failure handling.
tasks.progress: Sender domain phabfive.com is verified and Resend is connected. Provider test acceptance and failure handling passed; receipt in a real user inbox still needs confirmation.

tasks.name: Forgot password
tasks.how: Send a single-use, expiring reset link; let the user set a new password and return to sign-in.
tasks.progress: Completed Oct 9: deployed single-use, 30-minute reset links, session revocation and invitation-preserving recovery; local end-to-end and production route checks passed.

tasks.name: Email verification
tasks.how: Confirm email ownership and provide resend/change-address handling without stranding existing accounts.
tasks.progress: Verification and resend are deployed, with confirmation-based email changes and session revocation. Signup email behavior passed automated checks; actual inbox completion remains unverified.

tasks.name: Account and session settings
tasks.how: Allow secure email/password changes and sign-out of other sessions after sensitive account changes.
tasks.progress: Email/password settings, session list/revocation and sign-out with push detachment are deployed. Sensitive email/password changes still need a real-account end-to-end confirmation.

tasks.name: Account deletion
tasks.how: Add in-app and public web deletion requests with clear handling of posts, files and league history.
tasks.progress: In-app password-confirmed deletion and public deletion instructions deployed. Atomic cleanup, ownership protection and anonymized league history passed isolated database tests.

stages.title: Safety, permissions and support
stages.depends: After 1. Apply these controls to every later feature.
stages.gate: Unauthorized actions are denied; reports can be resolved and a backup restored.

tasks.name: Report content and users
tasks.how: Add report actions that save the reason and relevant content for moderator review.
tasks.progress: Post, comment and profile reports save reasons and snapshots with access checks. Isolated reporting and comment-removal tests passed.

tasks.name: Moderation console
tasks.how: Let authorized moderators review reports, remove content and restrict abusive accounts with an action log.
tasks.progress: Moderator report queue, resolve/dismiss/remove, restrictions/restore and action history deployed. Unauthorized and authorized API cases passed.

tasks.name: Role and privacy enforcement
tasks.how: Check owner, host and member rights on the server; keep private rails separate from rooms.
tasks.progress: Completed for the current web product Oct 9: owner/host/member rights, private-rail isolation, author-only editing, blocking and invitation consent are enforced and tested. Extend these checks as new features are added.

tasks.name: Abuse and upload protection
tasks.how: Filter objectionable content, limit abusive requests and reject unsupported or oversized uploads.
tasks.progress: Conservative text rules, per-user write/report limits and format/size validation deployed and tested. Automated image-content screening and broader abuse audit remain.

tasks.name: Help, privacy and community rules
tasks.how: Publish working support, privacy, deletion and community-standard screens, including required safety contacts.
tasks.progress: Public help, privacy, deletion and community rules plus authenticated support/appeals deployed; help route verified on staged production.

tasks.name: Backup and recovery baseline
tasks.how: Automate database protection and prove a test restore before later schema changes.
tasks.progress: Manual snapshot and recovery comparison completed; the restore finalized a replacement production branch. Original data retained; all existing content matched. Daily snapshot scheduling was rejected as unavailable; establish automation and a strictly isolated rehearsal procedure.

stages.title: Complete social, room and league controls
stages.depends: After 1-2. Extend the live 2.2 foundation; do not rebuild it.
stages.gate: Members and hosts can manage their own content, invitations and rooms correctly.

tasks.name: Rail membership controls
tasks.how: Add missing leave/remove-member, invite-revoke and owner-transfer controls with confirmation.
tasks.progress: Leave/remove-member, ownership transfer and invitation withdrawal deployed. Transfer/removal permissions and revoked watches/invites passed regression tests.

tasks.name: Invitation management
tasks.how: Show pending, accepted, declined and expired invites; let senders withdraw or resend eligible invitations.
tasks.progress: Pending invitation management, resend/withdraw and history deployed and tested. History records subsequent transitions; historical deleted invitations cannot be reconstructed.

tasks.name: Room administration
tasks.how: Complete host removal, room access controls and pinned announcements while preserving owner permissions.
tasks.progress: Room transfer, accepted-host checks and pinned announcements implemented alongside existing owner/host permissions. Full new room-administration browser walkthrough remains to verify.

tasks.name: Post and photo management
tasks.how: Finish supported edit/delete flows, image orientation/compression and useful upload retry messages.
tasks.progress: Post/photo edits and deletion retained; orientation-aware compression and unsupported-format retry guidance deployed. Physical-device orientation/format and retry checks remain; maximum three photos per private-rail post.

tasks.name: League administration finish
tasks.how: Add missing time-zone handling, roster removal, season archive and correction history around existing schedules/results.
tasks.progress: League time zones with DST validation, soft roster removal, archived seasons and correction history deployed and tested. Host-entered points and shared ranks retained.

tasks.name: Mobile web and accessibility finish
tasks.how: Fix keyboard, focus, empty/loading/error states and small-screen layouts across existing social and solver flows.
tasks.progress: My Rails navigation, optional nine-screen review with cards/action together per street (2.5.2), table frames and accessible reaction controls deployed. Current static render checks passed; the earlier 2.5 flow passed a 390-pixel check, but interactive 2.5.2 verification is blocked and the comprehensive keyboard/screen-reader/device audit remains.

stages.title: Notifications and destination links
stages.depends: After 3. Reuse the event service in the native apps.
stages.gate: An allowed alert is delivered once and opens the correct destination; muted alerts stay off.

tasks.name: Notification inbox
tasks.how: Store invitation, reply and game-update alerts with unread counts and read-state controls.
tasks.progress: Completed Oct 9: stored invitation, watched-post/stack, reply/tag, like, follow and followed-session alerts, unread counts and mark-read controls are deployed and tested.

tasks.name: Reliable delivery service
tasks.how: Queue alerts, retry temporary failures and prevent duplicate sends or stale reminders.
tasks.progress: Durable event/outbox queues, duplicate prevention, access rechecks and retries are implemented and tested with a stubbed push sender. Immediate delivery runs after writes, with activity-driven retries and a daily fallback. Physical-device delivery and future scheduled-reminder handling remain to verify.

tasks.name: Browser push
tasks.how: Register supported browsers for opt-in push and handle permission denial and expired subscriptions.
tasks.progress: Browser opt-in, service worker, production push credentials, permission handling and expired-device cleanup are deployed. This stays unchecked until receipt is verified on physical phones.

tasks.name: Notification preferences and reminders
tasks.how: Offer per-room/category mute controls and game reminders that update when schedules change.
tasks.progress: Join/leave a post or session watch and device-wide push on/off are delivered. Per-room/category mute preferences and schedule-aware reminders remain.

tasks.name: Secure deep-link routing
tasks.how: Preserve rail, room and event destinations through sign-in; validate membership before opening content.
tasks.progress: Rail/room invitation handoffs, post/session links and membership checks exist. Complete the signed-out destination audit and routing for future event/native screens.

stages.title: Live tournament tools
stages.depends: After 3-4. Extend the existing manual tournament-update posts.
stages.gate: A test event runs from setup through results without leaking private data or giving live solver advice.

tasks.name: Event setup and lifecycle
tasks.how: Create room-linked tournaments with schedule, blind structure and draft/live/finished states.
tasks.progress: Player-created tournament/cash-game sessions are delivered. Organizer-managed room events, blind structures and the full draft/live/finished lifecycle remain.

tasks.name: QR and link join
tasks.how: Generate event join codes; a scan opens the correct event and applies its membership rules.
tasks.progress: Not yet verified as implemented.

tasks.name: Live stack and status board
tasks.how: Show timestamped chip-count/status updates and reconnect cleanly; clearly identify self-reported data.
tasks.progress: Timestamped chip/big-blind/players-left updates and watch notifications are delivered. A consolidated live board, reconnect behavior and self-reported labels remain.

tasks.name: Blind clock and event updates
tasks.how: Synchronize levels, breaks and organizer corrections from the server so devices stay consistent.
tasks.progress: Not yet verified as implemented.

tasks.name: Event chat and completed-hand posts
tasks.how: Keep moderated discussion inside the event; only completed hands enter review/solver workflows.
tasks.progress: Private-rail comments and optional completed-hand reviews exist. Dedicated moderated event discussion remains.

tasks.name: Results and league connection
tasks.how: Finalize event results, record corrections and update linked league standings without duplicate scoring.
tasks.progress: Not yet verified as implemented.

tasks.progress: Not yet verified as implemented.

tasks.progress: The 2.3 web release passed 48 automated tests, local API/browser checks and builds; the timestamp update also passed build/browser checks. Final cross-product acceptance remains after native apps, events and purchases exist.

tasks.name: Performance and accessibility audit

tasks.progress: Staged production builds, promotion and live checks are in use. Operational alerts, usage limits and a proven restore/rollback exercise remain.

release_additions.name: Easy rail creation and member suggestions
release_additions.how: Create a rail is prominent and opens the searchable invitation list immediately.

release_additions.name: Invitation notifications
release_additions.how: Invitations appear in Notifications and People before the recipient joins; opted-in devices are queued for push.

release_additions.name: Join rail subscriptions
release_additions.how: Logo buttons follow a post or tournament/cash session without granting private-group access.

release_additions.name: Activity notification inbox
release_additions.how: Stack changes, tags, replies, likes, follows and followed-player sessions create permission-checked alerts.

release_additions.name: Post and comment editing/deletion
release_additions.how: Authors can edit/delete; room hosts may remove content but cannot rewrite another author.

release_additions.name: Automatic reply tags
release_additions.how: Replies insert a removable @tag; removing the tag suppresses the mention notification.

release_additions.name: Optional hand-review and update fields
release_additions.how: No individual field is required. Twenty-seven isolated saves verified one-item submissions. Completely empty posts remain blocked.

release_additions.name: Quick stack updates and photo placement
release_additions.how: Chips, current big blind and players left are first; photos follow, then other details.

release_additions.name: Built-in equity calculator
release_additions.how: The equity calculator replaces the Spot Solver entry; tied hands contribute correctly to equity.

release_additions.name: Post and comment timestamps
release_additions.how: All five post/comment surfaces show date, year, local time and time zone; edits retain the original posting time.
